builds.name: Reference: AP dive
builds.goal: Reference for Elise: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A form-switching pick diver who opens with human control and current-health damage, then finishes in spider form. Spider attacks, healing and Rappel support a short melee follow-through. Compare human current-health opening with spider finishing attacks, keeping target HP and form explicit. Rappel and spider healing buy access but do not make every spell an on-hit. AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window.
builds.summary: AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window.
testPlan: Kit question for Elise: Compare human current-health opening with spider finishing attacks, keeping target HP and form explicit. Rappel and spider healing buy access but do not make every spell an on-hit.

Start with the early core (Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.

Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

kitEvidence.formula: Human Form: Elise fires a cocoon, Stunning and revealing the first enemy hit for [1.6 / 1.8 / 2 / 2.2 / 2.4] seconds.
Human Form: Elise summons an explosive spider that moves to a location and explodes when it nears an enemy or after 3 seconds. The spider deals @spell.EliseHumanW:TotalDamage@ magic damage.
Human Form: Elise transforms into a menacing spider, becoming melee, gaining access to Spider Form Abilities and summons all dormant Spiderlings.

Elise begins the game with a point in her Ultimate, allowing her to shapeshift between Human Form and Spider Form.

Human Form: Elise's Ability hits grant her a dormant Spiderling, up to @spell.EliseR:BaseSpiderlingsStored@.

Spider Form: Attacks deal an additional @spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalDamage@ magic damage and restore @spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalHealing@ Health.
Human Form: Elise injects neurotoxin, dealing [40 / 70 / 100 / 130 / 160] plus [(4 + (0.03) × AP) × (0.01)] current Health magic damage.

builds.goal: Test rappel spider boxer against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Spider Queen gives Elise's own attacks 0.15 AP magic damage and 0.08 AP healing; spider W grants a three-second attack-speed burst. Rappel's descent amplifies the passive for five seconds, so Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test a sustained landing window.
testPlan: Required state: Descend on the target with spider W available.
Count Elise's own attacks and healing separately from spiderlings.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Short buff duration and squishy melee exposure can lose to normal burst.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Spiderlings do not automatically inherit Nashor or Spellblade; Rappel amplification dispatch needs confirmation.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Bloodletter's Curse, Spirit Visage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
